## Decision

<a id="PageBundle"></a>

### Bundle of the page

`PageBundle` · `src/page.ts:24`

How esbuild bundles the page's program: a module, since the program waits at its top level for what it builds, for browsers that run ES2022, without licence comments, in UTF-8.

| Case | Value |

| target | es2022 |
| legalComments | none |

## Architecture decision

<a id="ThePageIsTheLibrarys"></a>

### The page is the library's

`ThePageIsTheLibrarys` · `src/page.ts:60` · status: **held**

Trame's page moved into libs/documents (documents 0.5.0), with its program; the engine bundles the program and gives Page what it reads with.

Context: The page was Trame's: a project could not make its own, nor change its look but by amending Trame's graph. Its HTML, its CSS and its program read nothing of the engine's but the intermediate format and what the page decides.

Consequences: Page and the page's program are libs/documents'; the engine bundles the program it assembles for Browser and gives it to Page, with the program's name, the graph packed, its title. Each project will assemble the page with its own choices (trame init writes them, later); until then the engine's program serves every project.

| Rejected | Why |
|---|---|
| The page left in Trame | the commands that write it (export, dev) could not leave the engine |
| The engine writing the whole page through its API | the page's look would stay out of reach of the projects |

- Decided by: trame
- Serves: [A specification that runs](product.md#ExecutableSpecification)
- Applied by: [The page's program, bundled](#PageScript), [How the engine makes a page](#PageMadeOnTheMachine)

## Technical choice

<a id="PageMadeOnTheMachine"></a>

### How the engine makes a page

`PageMadeOnTheMachine` · `src/page.ts:46` · status: **held**

On a machine and in the scenarios, Page reads its style sheets beside the library and the graph a page carries is compressed with gzip.

In [Local](architecture.md#Local), [Test](architecture.md#Test):

| Port | Answered by | Which is |
|---|---|---|
| [Packing the graph](../libs/documents/releases/0.5.1/docs/page.md#GraphPacking) | [gzip, in base64](../libs/documents/releases/0.5.1/docs/page.md#GzipInBase64) | an implementation |
| [The page's style sheets](../libs/documents/releases/0.5.1/docs/page.md#PageSheets) | [Style sheets beside the library](../libs/documents/releases/0.5.1/docs/page.md#SheetsBesideTheLibrary) | an implementation |

Context: The page's style sheets are files of libs/documents, which its versions carry; the graph a page carries is packed as the browser unpacks it.
